name: FOM Technologies A/S
summary: Fom Technologies A/S produces and sells slot die machines and equipment. The company provides roll and sheet based slot-die coating machines that enables researchers, scientists, and professionals to discover, develop, and commercialize new functional materials. The company also offers slot die heads that provide access to a coating platform for a range of thin film applications. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark.
